name: Count of rules triggered per client

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource1}}  ("\"waf_executed\":\"1\"") 
| json "client_ip", "waf_executed", "waf_rule_id" as client_ip, waf_executed, waf_rule_id nodrop
| where waf_executed = "1"
| count_distinct(waf_rule_id) as unique_threats by client_ip 
| top 10 client_ip by unique_threats

description: See the count of rule ids that were triggered for each client sorted by high to low
